mapper.select: SELECT IF(COUNT(*), MAX(summarySeq) + 1, 1) AS summarySeq FROM DOGPOO_AI_CHATBOT_SUMMARY WHERE userId = #{userId} AND mode = #{mode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DOGPOO_AI_CHATBOT_SUMMARY (mode, summarySeq, endSeq, userId, content) VALUES (#{mode}, #{summarySeq}, #{endSeq}, #{userId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT userId, mode, CAST(CAST( TRUNCATE(MAX(chatSeq) / ${summarySize}, 0) AS UNSIGNED ) * ${summarySize} AS VARCHAR (10) ) AS lastSeq FROM DOGPOO_AI_CHATBOT_HISTORY GROUP BY userId, mode HAVING CAST( TRUNCATE(MAX(chatSeq) / ${summarySize}, 0) AS UNSIGNED ) * ${summarySize} > 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DOGPOO_AI_CHATBOT_LONGTERM (mode, endSeq, userId, content) VALUES (#{mode}, #{endSeq}, #{userId}, #{content})
